fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-08-13 around 21:50 hrs, it was reported that the complainant scanned a QR code shared by a caller who spoke of a refund, and Rs. 1,50,000 was debited instead. The online submission was made by Ajith Sekar (9000000063). Dharani Anand (9000000114) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The complainant mentioned the account SYN-ACC-100051 as the destination of the transfer. A further person, Mathan Raman, an intermediary, using the number 9000000187, is stated to be associated with the incident. A person named Vasanth Mani, associated with the number 9000000382, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. Items referenced in the complaint: digital documents and mobile phone records. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00467, as the mobile number 9000000382 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly posed as an online buyer and requested payment approval.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, shopping complex, digital document, mobile number, witness, suspect, phone records
